QuestInfo.name: Policeman in Danger
QuestInfo.1: The Policeman at the Harbor mentioned that the monsters have completely taken over the area. He asked for your help in clearing the place out. Eliminate #r50 Overlord As#k and #r50 Overlord Bs#k for the Policeman.
QuestInfo.2: The Policeman you met at Midnight Harbor in the year 2099 asked you to help him eliminate some monsters, so you eliminated Overlord A and Overlord B monsters.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 468,451\nCan proceed to Shelter Key quest\n
QuestInfo.0: You've run into the Policeman at the Harbor that you reached by taking the #t3994444# to 2099.

0.0: It's dangerous here. Please go somewhere safer. A bunch of unidentifiable monsters appeared and took over the harbor.\r\n#L0##bWould you like me to help you?#l\n#k
0.1: Would you? I'm trying to eliminate the monsters that have taken over the harbor, but they outnumber me and I don't know if I can handle all of them on my own. Would you help me eliminate these monsters?

yes.0: While I get the citizens to a safe place, could you take down #r50 Overlord As#k and #r50 Overlord Bs#k? We better get moving while we have the element of surprise!

no.0: It's dangerous here. Please get yourself to the nearest shelter where it's safe. Hurry!

1.0: How did it go?\r\n#b#L0#I took care of the monsters as you requested.#l\n#k
1.1: You have done a great thing for us. Everyone at the Harbor was able to evacuate.

mob.0: Get rid of 50 Overlord As and 50 Overlord Bs while I get citizens to a safe place. Please, hurry!
